title: An optimal transport foundation for a class of dynamically consistent risk measures
summary: We study a class of dynamically consistent risk measures that robustify a time-homogeneous Markovian reference model by allowing for distributional uncertainty in its transition laws. We start from one-step convex risk evaluations in which ambiguity is captured by penalized worst-case expectations over alternative transition laws. Imposing time consistency then yields a convex monotone semigroup on bounded continuous payoff functions, and this semigroup represents the associated dynamic risk measure.
